verdict.rationale: The public GitHub repository neondatabase/neon describes Neon as "an open-source serverless Postgres database platform" and documents compiling and running it locally, so the core database source is readable. missing for 10: the specific open-source license is never named in the evidence, there is no evidence on whether newer platform services (Auth, Functions, Object Storage, AI Gateway) are open source, and there is no independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
